title: Dulles keeps holding court in his Georgetown brownstone

tellings.quote: But Dulles didn't leave. He didn't leave Washington. He had his whole setup over in Georgetown in his

plain: After leaving the CIA in the early 1960s, its former director Allen Dulles stayed in Washington and kept running "his whole setup" from his brownstone house in Georgetown. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this without naming a source, while talking about UFOs and President Kennedy. The point is that Dulles may have kept his power after losing his post.
